_comment: Reproducibility template (NO real keys) for the external WORM audit-copy S3 identity. Merge this identity into the out-of-repo seaweed-s3.json (the file the seaweedfs service mounts at /etc/seaweed/s3.json), generate real accessKey/secretKey, and hand them to the WORM adapter via MNEMOSYNE_AUDIT_WORM_ACCESS_KEY / _SECRET_KEY. The per-bucket 'Admin:mnemosyne-audit-worm' action is least-privilege: it authorises object-lock/retention/versioning ONLY on the audit-worm bucket and cannot touch the B6 multimodal/parametric buckets used by the 'mnemosyne' app identity.
